New Products.title: OpenRouter raises $113M Series B
New Products.description: OpenRouter, an AI model routing platform, raised $113M in Series B funding. This highlights continued investment in AI infrastructure and developer tooling for accessing multiple LLM APIs through unified interfaces.

New Products.title: Claude Opus 4.8 Launch and Dynamic Workflows
New Products.description: Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8 with improved performance and accuracy. Introduced dynamic workflows that adapt to task complexity. Enhanced terminal interaction with better command suggestions and multi-step execution support. Community feedback shows strong positive reception with examples of generating UI from Figma screenshots directly in existing codebases.

New Products.title: Auto-review Run Mode (v3.6)
New Products.description: New auto-review run mode that allows Cursor to work for longer with fewer approval prompts and safer execution. This improves the autonomous coding experience with better safety controls.

New Products.title: My LLM coding workflow going into 2026 - Hacker News Discussion
New Products.description: Hacker News discussion about LLM coding workflows, with skepticism about whether AI tools actually provide speedup over doing work yourself. Users debate effectiveness of AI coding assistants and their impact on developer productivity.

New Products.title: Graphs that explain the state of AI in 2026 - Environmental Impact
New Products.description: Hacker News discussion on environmental impact of AI, noting training one LLM produces emissions equivalent to 17,000 people over a year. Community debates sustainability concerns with AI scaling.

New Products.title: Copilot Memory Controls and CLI Integration
New Products.description: GitHub added more controls for Copilot Memory deletion and scope. Repository admins can now disable Copilot Memory via repository-level off switch. New /memory commands in Copilot CLI: /memory list, /memory delete, and /memory off for viewing, deleting, and opting out of memory storage.

New Products.title: Cursor Automations and /loop Skill Launch
New Products.description: Cursor introduced Automations for recurring development tasks and added /loop skill for iterative code improvement. Implemented shared canvases for team collaboration. Offering 50% discount on agent runs for newly created automations. Multiple meetups and hackathons organized across Europe and Asia in May 2026 showing growing community engagement.

New Products.title: Notes on Pope Leo XIV's encyclical on AI - Magnifica Humanitas
New Products.description: Vatican released encyclical 'Magnifica Humanitas' on safeguarding the human person in the time of AI. Document described as some of the clearest writing on ethics of integrating AI into modern society.

New Products.title: Ask HN: What are your predictions for 2026?
New Products.description: Hacker News discussion includes predictions about AI bubble bursting and companies deciding that 'LLM-coding is not worth it after accounting for the downsides'. Mentions LLMs for photos/videos still not being viable. Community skepticism about AI coding ROI.

New Products.title: Using AI to improve coding slowly - Discussion
New Products.description: May 25, 2026 blog post discussed on Hacker News about using AI to write better code more slowly. Examines nuanced approach to AI coding assistance, focusing on quality over speed.

New Products.title: Continue 0.8.12: Context Window and VS Code Improvements
New Products.description: Continue.dev released version 0.8.12 with improved context window handling for better code comprehension. Added support for additional model providers and fixed issues with VS Code integration. Focus on stability and expanded model compatibility.

New Products.title: Superset: Multi-Agent Orchestration IDE Launch
New Products.description: Superset launched as an agent-native IDE that orchestrates multiple AI coding agents in parallel using git worktree isolation to prevent conflicts. Core innovation is multi-agent orchestration engine with code editing as supporting feature. Supports Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Cursor Agent, and other CLI-based coding agents. Features remote workspaces to run agents on other machines, preserving local memory and CPU. YC P26 batch project with 11k+ GitHub stars. Community describes it as 'not an agent, but an OS for running agents'.

New Products.title: Google Antigravity CLI Launch
New Products.description: Google released Antigravity CLI, a terminal-based coding agent that allows developers to run and monitor AI coding agents directly from command line. Features multi-step reasoning, multi-file editing, tool calling, and persistent history. Ranked #2 on Product Hunt May 23, 2026. Designed specifically for SSH sessions and keyboard-focused workflows providing the most lightweight way to invoke, monitor, and interact with Antigravity agents.

New Products.title: Google Antigravity CLI
New Products.description: A terminal-based coding agent CLI that allows developers to run and monitor AI coding agents directly from their command line. Features multi-step reasoning, multi-file editing, tool calling, and persistent history. Ranked #2 on Product Hunt May 23, 2026. Designed for SSH sessions and keyboard-focused workflows.

New Products.title: 2M-Code
New Products.description: Multi-Mind — A terminal-native AI coding platform where teams of specialized, multi-provider LLM agents (Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, Mistral) collaborate to plan, implement, and review code together via a shared SQLite event bus.

New Products.title: claude-code-workflow-creator
New Products.description: A Claude Code skill for authoring Workflow tool scripts: deterministic multi-agent orchestration. Preview of an unreleased feature.

New Products.title: itops-agent-platform
New Products.description: Enterprise IT Operations multi-Agent automation platform based on LLMs. ITOps Agent Platform is a full-stack operations automation platform with visual workflow orchestration, combining multiple AI Agents for server management, alert handling, fault diagnosis, log analysis, script management, and scheduled operations.

New Products.title: Google Android CLI 1.0
New Products.description: Released at Google I/O 2026, giving AI coding agents like Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and Antigravity direct access to Android Studio. Introduces 'android studio' command for agents to retrieve knowledge and access IDE tools, enabling agents to inspect projects, run Compose previews, check dependencies, and perform file operations.

New Products.title: Google Agents CLI
New Products.description: Google's unified CLI for AI coding agents announced at Google I/O 2026, described as 'create to production in one CLI.' Turns any coding agent into a production-ready tool with specialized commands for Android project inspection, Compose previews, dependency checking, and file operations. Works with Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Cursor.

New Products.title: LobeHub
New Products.description: Chief Agent Operator (CAO) platform that organizes AI agents into 7×24 operations. Manages multi-agent teams with agent-to-agent protocols, coordination, and adversarial verification. Ranked #5 of the week on Product Hunt for May 18, 2026. Acts as an MCP server for multi-coding agents.

New Products.title: Collapsible Session Folders, Archive All Sessions, Default Member Roles
New Products.description: Sessions can be organized into collapsible folders. 'Archive all' option in sidebar menu. Enterprise admins can configure default roles for new organization members. GHES app registration restriction. Copyable Organization ID.

New Products.title: OpenHuman
New Products.description: Open-source AI harness that remembers everything about you and gets smarter with use. Features one-click setup with personalization that learns user preferences in minutes. Trended #3 on Product Hunt in mid-May 2026, marketed as the first agent harness with minute-scale learning capability.

New Products.title: Agent View: Multi-session management dashboard
New Products.description: New 'claude agents' command opens a dedicated screen showing all Claude Code sessions with visibility into running tasks, blocked items awaiting user input, and completed work. Also introduced /goal command for persistent tasks across turns, fast mode now defaults to Opus 4.7, and Rewind menu can summarize earlier context.

New Features.title: Version 2.1.156 - Opus 4.8 Launch and Dynamic Workflows
New Features.description: Released Claude Opus 4.8 with improved performance and accuracy. Introduced dynamic workflows that adapt to task complexity. Enhanced terminal interaction with better command suggestions and multi-step execution support.

New Features.title: Windsurf 2.3.15: Devin Local Agent and Claude Opus 4.8 Integration
New Features.description: Windsurf updated with improved Devin Local agent context handling and added support for Claude Opus 4.8. Enhanced Cascade prediction features and improved file navigation. Community discussions highlight Windsurf's superior hooks support and full MCP support compared to Cursor. Ongoing Devin integration since January 2026 aims to make Windsurf a command center for human and AI engineering.

New Features.title: Version 2.3.15 - Devin Local Agent and Claude Opus 4.8
New Features.description: Updated Devin Local agent with improved context handling. Added support for Claude Opus 4.8 model. Enhanced Cascade prediction features and improved file navigation.

New Features.title: MPort
New Features.description: Migrate LLM apps between models safely — then benchmark old vs. new to prove the upgrade. Agent skill for behavior-preserving migrations + a runnable eval harness.

New Features.title: Search Across Conversation History
New Features.description: Codex CLI 0.134.0 - Added search across conversation history with /search command. Profile selector improvements for easier model switching. Enhanced MCP setup with better error messages and validation.

New Features.title: Version 0.8.12 - Context Window Improvements
New Features.description: Improved context window handling for better code comprehension. Added support for additional model providers. Fixed issues with VS Code integration.

New Features.title: Fixes for Devin Local and Bug Fixes
New Features.description: Version 2.3.1012 - Repaired hooks for Devin Local to allow blocking user prompts, improved plan mode in Devin Local to work in the OS sandbox, and increased remote server startup timeout from 2.5s to 6s.

New Features.title: Surgical Code Edits and Session Portability
New Features.description: Gemini CLI v0.43.0 (May 22, 2026) - Surgical Code Edits feature for precise code modifications. Session Portability allows export/import of sessions. Adaptive Token Estimation for better token usage prediction. Improved UI Rendering and Enhanced Agent Architecture.

New Features.title: gemini-antigravity-cli
New Features.description: Gemini antigravity 2.0 CLI — Google terminal AI agent tool with migration guide, MCP server plugin, slash commands, and Gemini 3.5 Flash coding agent

New Features.title: Appshots, Goal Mode, Remote Computer Use
New Features.description: May 21, 2026 update introduced Appshots for saving application states, Goal Mode for persistent multi-step tasks, and Remote Computer Use capabilities for controlling remote machines.

New Features.title: Model Updates and Memory Controls
New Features.description: Updated underlying models on May 20, 2026. Introduced memory controls allowing users to manage what context Copilot retains. Enhanced agent sessions with better multi-step reasoning.

New Features.title: Antigravity CLI
New Features.description: Google's replacement for Gemini CLI, announced at Google I/O 2026 as part of the Antigravity 2.0 agent-first development platform. Features multiple agents executing tasks in parallel across Google AI Studio, Android, and Firebase. More lightweight than Gemini CLI, with shutdown scheduled for June 18, 2026.

New Features.title: Google Antigravity 2.0
New Features.description: Google's agent-first IDE launched at I/O 2026, featuring a standalone desktop application and CLI tool. Designed as an independent AI development platform with centralized workspace to steer, customize, and orchestrate coding agents. Features memory efficiency breakthroughs and expanded context management for agentic development.

New Features.title: Shared Canvases, /loop Skill, and Composer 2.5
New Features.description: Canvases created by agents can now be shared with team members via links. /loop skill enables agents to run prompts repeatedly on a schedule until outcomes are achieved. Cursor Automations moved to Agents Window with multi-repo and no-repo support. Composer 2.5 brings improved intelligence for sustained work on long-running tasks.

New Features.title: Bug Fixes and Improvements
New Features.description: Version 2.3.1008 - Fixed availability issues with swe-check model for some users, improved terminal processing performance, and restored conversation sharing.

New Technologies.title: Ultracode
New Technologies.description: UltraCode is a local AI-assisted coding CLI inspired by Claude Code. It runs agentic coding workflows in your workspace with OpenAI-compatible models, function-calling tools, task planning, memory, permissions, hooks, background commands, MCP integration, and subagent support.

New Technologies.title: SQLite AGENTS.md - AI code and bug report policy
New Technologies.description: SQLite published AGENTS.md clarifying their stance on AI-generated contributions: they don't accept agentic code without prior agreement, but will accept agentic bug reports with reproducible test cases. This comes as AI tools flood projects with automated issue reports of varying quality.

New Technologies.title: agent-workflows

Others.title: The pressure - AI-assisted security reports overwhelming curl team
Others.description: Daniel Stenberg reports curl team receiving 4-5x more security reports than 2024, averaging more than one report per day. AI-assisted reports are detailed and high-quality, creating unprecedented pressure on maintainers. Most vulnerabilities found are LOW or MEDIUM severity.

Others.title: Microsoft Copilot Cowork exfiltration vulnerability via rendered images
Others.description: Microsoft Copilot Cowork allowed agents to send emails to user's inbox without approval, which could leak data via rendered images in messages. External image requests in emails could exfiltrate data, including OneDrive pre-authenticated download links through prompt injection.

Others.title: Armin Ronacher on 'slop issues' - AI-generated GitHub reports
Others.description: Armin Ronacher criticizes AI-generated GitHub issues that aren't in human voice - they contain observed problems but AI rewords them inaccurately with high confidence. Desires issue reports condensed to: 1) command run, 2) expected result, 3) actual result, 4) exact error/log.

Others.title: The memory shortage is causing a repricing of consumer electronics
Others.description: Memory manufacturers have fixed wafer capacity split between DDR, LPDDR, and HBM. AI growth pushing HBM from 2% to 20% of allocation by end of 2026. A single GB of HBM consumes 3x more wafer capacity than DDR/LPDDR, constraining consumer RAM production for several years.

Others.title: FTC settles charges over 'active listening' AI marketing deception
Others.description: FTC required Cox Media Group and two other firms to pay nearly $1M for deceiving customers about 'active listening' AI-powered marketing. Service did not actually listen to conversations or use voice data - it resold email lists from other data brokers. Confirms theory that 'active listening' was misleading marketing for standard ad targeting.
